body:
Last updated: 2026-02-24 (Rachel)

Purpose
- Single place to track air-gapped/offline Redwood Private pilots for signed offline bundles.
- Used for weekly CS/SE/Eng checkpoint: milestones, owners, risks, next meetings, blockers.
- NOTE: This is a working tracker; details may duplicate Confluence/HubSpot/Jira. Keep it current + link out for artifacts.

Legend
- Status: Not started | In progress | Blocked | Done
- Severity (risks/blockers): P0 (release/pilot stop) | P1 (major) | P2 (minor)

============================================================
1) Rollup view (all pilots)
============================================================

Top-level milestones (program)
- M1: Customer requirements confirmed + crypto constraints captured (owner: Fatima) — Done (2025-11)
- M2: Signed bundle format + manifest + verification available in pilot build (owner: Ethan / Connor) — Done (2026-01)
- M3: Trust store + key rotation path validated with at least 1 air-gapped customer (owner: Connor / Hanae) — In progress
- M4: Support readiness: runbooks + error taxonomy + escalation paths (owner: Dev Patel) — In progress
- M5: Audit logging / export guidance validated (owner: Kevin Osei) — In progress
- M6: Pilot exit criteria met (per customer) and go/no-go for limited GA (owner: Vivek / Rachel) — In progress

Current cross-pilot risks
- P0: Key rotation readiness (air-gapped trust store updates lag) could cause “unknown key” installs. Mitigation: pre-announce, ship trust store update bundle, add docs + support scripts, include trust store in support bundle.
- P1: Offline transfer integrity issues (zip tooling, line endings, AV tampering) causing hash mismatch. Mitigation: recommend tooling + provide “bundle inspect” command + checksum verification instructions.
- P1: Time skew / no reliable time source leading to “not yet valid” signature/cert. Mitigation: installer diagnostics + clear guidance; define acceptable validity windows and time override for debugging only.

Operating cadence
- Weekly pilot standup: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT (CS/SE + Eng + Release + Support)
- Security/Compliance check-in (as needed): Thu 11:00–11:30 PT

============================================================
4) Notes / scratch (keep short)
============================================================

- If a customer is blocked, always capture: bundle build-id, installer version, exact error code/message, and output from `bundle inspect` (or equivalent) + file hashes.
- For air-gapped installs, we need to proactively confirm time source assumptions (manual time setting? internal NTP? none?). We’ve now seen time skew at least once in Helios staging.
- Make sure every pilot has a clear break-glass path documented + signed off, but treat break-glass usage as a pilot “incident” (must be reviewed after).

Owner reminders
- Keep HubSpot account notes in sync when we change target dates or identify new stakeholders.
- When we hit a pilot exit milestone, email Vivek + Connor + Dev Patel so release gating/support readiness stays aligned.
